Our love story

The Groom

Sunmibola

Some time ago, I came across her on a social app, and I was deeply convinced that I wanted to be with her.

So I left her a few messages, and none of them got a reply. But I wasn’t ready to give up on her that easily. I knew I wanted her attention.

So I tried another way. I decided to patronize her business through the same app. She was all business, straight to the point, with no room for small talk.

Then one day I left her a message, and her reply was soft. I was surprised, and I couldn’t stop smiling. Something had changed, and I knew it.

That one gentle reply was all I needed. I didn’t know it yet, but I had just started talking to the woman I would marry.

The Bride

Tunmise

I never even noticed his earlier messages. I was always scared of being scammed or deceived on social apps, so I kept to myself.

Then one day, after a very long day, I was tired and bored. I opened my messages just to distract myself, and there it was, a message from Sunmibola.

“A few minutes of chatting won’t hurt.”

That is what I told myself. But those few minutes turned into the whole night, and I had no idea that one small decision would lead me to the love of my life.

Now we are getting married, and we would love you to celebrate the rest of our story with us.

Oluwatunmise & Oluwasunmibola
